svg.metadata: {"source_asset": {"id": "core.organelle.autophagosome", "name": "Autophagosome", "category": "organelle", "tags": ["autophagosome", "autophagy", "vesicle", "cargo", "organelle"], "description": "Original vector autophagosome with an irregular double membrane, sequestered cargo fragments, and editable semantic regions.", "file": "svg/autophagosome.svg", "source_type": "original_vector_draft", "license": "CC0-1.0", "provenance": "Original vector draft created for Figure Studio from a generic organelle concept; no proprietary reference image, scraping, tracing, or protected asset-library recreation was used.", "style_family": "figure-studio-soft-line-v1", "review_status": "visual_reviewed_2026_07_18", "style_status": "soft_line_v1_organelle_refresh", "mvp_quality": "curated", "editable_region_count": 3, "reviewer_notes": "Rebuilt as a visibly double-membrane autophagosome with separated sequestered cargo fragments; the irregular contour avoids a generic circular-badge read.", "editable_color_regions": [{"id": "vesicle", "label": "Autophagosome membrane", "default": "#D9F4E5", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "cargo", "label": "Cargo contents", "default": "#B8B5FF", "paint": "fill"}, {"id": "outline", "label": "Vesicle and cargo outline", "default": "#26323D", "paint": "stroke"}]}, "source_archive": "scientific-packs(1).zip", "source_svg": "scientific-packs/core-biology/svg/autophagosome.svg", "output_style": "Style 4", "batch": "008", "source_record_is_unmodified": true, "output_review_status": "XML, source-structure checks and rendered visual review; not a new scientific validation"}
